review_state.title: Your Customers Are Asking AI Who to Hire. Right Now, It Isn't Saying You.
review_state.description: More buyers now ask AI assistants who to hire instead of Googling. Here's how to make sure your business shows up when they do.
review_state.preview_text: Picture the moment someone finally decides to fix the problem you solve. A year ago, they opened Google, typed a few words, and skimmed a page of blue links until something looked credible. This year, a growing number of them do something different: they open ChatGPT, Gemini, or Perplexity and simply ask.
